title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage: Secondary Payer Claim Routes and Follow-Up
content:
How the secondary share of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage coinsurance is claimed, followed up and treated on denial depends on the tier.

| Tier | How the secondary share is claimed | Follow-up of an unpaid secondary share (calendar days after the secondary charge is posted) | Share denied by the secondary payer rebilled to the resident |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part A Without Supplemental Coverage | No secondary claim | 0 (no secondary payer) | No |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan A or B | No secondary claim | 0 (no secondary payer) | No |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan K | COBA crossover — Medicare's automatic crossover to the Medigap carrier | 45 | Yes |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan L | COBA crossover — Medicare's automatic crossover to the Medigap carrier | 45 | Yes |
| Medicare Part A with Full-Coinsurance Medigap | COBA crossover — Medicare's automatic crossover to the Medigap carrier | 45 | Yes |
| Medicare Part A with QMB Medicaid Crossover | State Medicaid crossover | 60 | No |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Full-Coinsurance Medigap secondary charge posted on the 19th of a month and still unpaid is followed up 45 calendar days later; a QMB crossover share still unpaid is followed up 60 calendar days after its posting.
